title: The Arrogance of Having Outgrown Arrogance
why_read: A personal reflective essay on arrogance and mentorship with no technical content relevant to software engineering practice.
analysis: This is a personal essay recounting a conversation with a retired principal engineer about career lessons, arrogance, and self-perception over time. It's a soft, reflective piece about professional growth and humility rather than anything technical. While mildly relatable for engineers thinking about career development, it offers no engineering substance for a technical digest.
